Class InventoryView

java.lang.Object
com.squad83.views.InventoryView
public class InventoryView extends Object
JavaFX view for managing the shop's inventory. It displays all inventory items in a table along with a status that flags items at or below their reorder threshold, and provides a form to add, update, restock, clear, and refresh items stored in the database.

Squad 83

  • Method Details

    • getView

      public static javafx.scene.Parent getView()
      Builds the inventory management screen, including the title, the inventory table, the input form, the restock row, and the action buttons. Selecting a row in the table fills the form with that item's values. Inventory items are loaded from the database before the view is returned.
      Returns:
      the root node of the inventory view

    • loadItems

      private static void loadItems()
      Loads all inventory items from the database, ordered by inventory ID, and places them in the table. If a database error occurs, an error dialog is shown instead of propagating the exception.

    • addItem

      private static void addItem()
      Validates the form and inserts a new inventory item into the database using the values currently entered. The new item's ID is one more than the largest existing ID. On success the table is refreshed and the form is cleared.

    • updateItem

      private static void updateItem()
      Updates the inventory item selected in the table with the values currently in the form. An error is shown if no item is selected or the form is invalid. On success the table is refreshed and the form is cleared.

    • restockItem

      private static void restockItem()
      Adds the amount entered in the restock field to the quantity on hand of the item selected in the table. An error is shown if no item is selected or the amount is not a number greater than 0. On success the table is refreshed and the form is cleared.

    • validateForm

      private static boolean validateForm()
      Checks that the form fields hold valid input: the name must not be empty, a category and unit must be chosen, and the quantity, reorder threshold, and unit cost must be non-negative numbers. An error dialog is shown for the first problem found.
      Returns:
      true if all form fields are valid, false otherwise

    • isNonNegativeNumber

      private static boolean isNonNegativeNumber(String text)
      Checks whether the given text is a number that is 0 or greater.
      Parameters:
      text - the text to check
      Returns:
      true if the text is a non-negative number, false otherwise

    • clearForm

      private static void clearForm()
      Resets the form to its default state by clearing every text field, removing the category and unit selections, and clearing the table selection.
